mentions.name: Fallinorg
mentions.description: A Mac app that organizes files by looking inside each file to understand its content and moving it to the right folder. All processing happens locally on the Mac with no cloud or servers. It works with PDFs, text, Markdown and many other file types, with ePub support next and Microsoft Office and iWork support planned; version 3.0 beta adds custom categories.
mentions.problem: Messy, unorganized folders on the Mac that pile up because files aren't sorted into the right places.
mentions.audience: Mac users with messy folders, stated broadly to anyone whose folders are unorganized
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building https://fallinorg.com/, a Mac app that organizes your files.

It looks inside each file to see what it’s about, then moves it to the right folder for you.

Everything happens on your Mac, so nothing leaves your computer. No clouds, no servers.
